ticketTitle: Convert Permissions list to card view
ticketDescription:
## Source

Discovery `table-list-to-card-all-modules`, file: `.caf/discovery/table-list-to-card-all-modules/prd.md` + `flow.md`

## Problem

`apps/web/src/modules/permission/pages/index.vue` uses `<DataTable>`, forcing horizontal scroll on tablet/mobile, inconsistent with already-card modules.

## Target User

Outlet owners/managers/admins managing Permissions on desktop and tablet/mobile.

## Scope of This Ticket

Convert `apps/web/src/modules/permission/pages/index.vue` only to a responsive card grid, following `apps/web/src/modules/transaction/pages/index.vue`'s pattern. Card shows code, description, created date. Preserve search/filter, pagination (`UiPagination`), RBAC-gated row actions, and empty-state messaging.

## Out-of-Scope

* Any other module's list page
* create.vue/edit.vue/detail.vue forms
* Backend API, pagination contract, or RBAC permission code changes
* New shared `UiListCard` component decision (implementer's call)

## Flow

Search/filter unchanged → records render as card grid → row actions as icon buttons in card footer (`isHasPermission()` gated) → `UiPagination` unchanged → empty state follows `transaction`/`notification` pattern.

## Success Metric

No `<DataTable>` remaining in this file; search/filter/pagination/actions functional; no horizontal scroll at 375px viewport.

## Dependency

`UiCard`, `UiPagination` shared components; `transaction` module as design reference.
